answer: Agents must stake a bonded identity whose key derives from a slow-mixing degradation curve, so a sybil cannot wander across many identities without replicating costly thermal history. Each agent's stake locks in a shared vault that decays as silicon-germanium lattice, letting peers audit a reef of unforgeable entropy against recycled keys. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
